templates.why_chosen: The Control plane's LazyDAG is a real branching graph: telemetry triangles and an anomaly feed green expert-diamond nodes (RC1 to RC3) that merge into orange root-cause boxes, at medium confidence.
templates.what_to_learn: Colour-code a small live DAG by node role, blue/cyan structure, green computation, orange merged output, light-blue triangles for inputs, and pair it with a small-multiples grid of the same icon style for a library holding many such graphs.
